title: Follow-up אוטומטי — Audit ואז STOP לפני הפעלה חיה
whatWasStored: Worker can check follow-up approval on send. Outbox stores followup_approved, followup_days, followup_max=1, followup_count=0. No scheduler was enabled. No MAIL_DISPATCH_MODE change. No claims-mail-dispatch live send.
whyStop: Real automatic Gmail follow-up requires leaving MAIL_DISPATCH_MODE=dry_run and/or a live scheduled dispatcher. Owner forbade that without extra approval.
replyCancels: Incoming import on the same Gmail thread sets outbox.track_status=reply_received so a future dispatcher can skip. Live follow-up is not fired today.
idempotency: Existing send_claim idempotency_key remains. Follow-up live send not activated so duplicate live follow-up cannot occur.
needsOwnerApprovalFor: Wire approved outbox rows to claims-mail-dispatch / claims_upsert_mail_followup for real Gmail
